description: Opens a URL in a new browser tab with the simulator on for its site, optionally choosing the devices. Waits until every device has loaded. The site must have been allowed once from the extension's toolbar button in Firefox/Zen.

devices.description: Devices to show, left to right. Omit to keep the site's saved devices.

browser.description: Browser UI and user agent to emulate. Defaults to Safari on Apple devices, Chrome on Android.

frame.description: Draw device bezels, status bars and browser UI

sync.description: Navigate every device when one of them navigates

tab_id.description: Reuse this tab instead of opening a new one

zoom.description: How large devices are drawn on screen

name: view_sim_open
title: Open a URL in the simulator
